# SvelteKit Developer Skill

> **Category:** Tech Skills > Frontend > Svelte

## Overview

Builds full-stack applications with SvelteKit including file-based routing, server-side rendering, form actions, and API endpoints

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [svelte-kit-developer-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
svelte-kit-developer-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@svelte-kit-developer` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Configure SvelteKit with file-based routing
- Implement load functions for SSR data fetching
- Build form actions for progressive enhancement
- Create API endpoints with server routes

## Technology Standards Applied

- **SvelteKit Routing**: File-based routing with +page and +layout
- **Load Functions**: Server and universal data loading patterns
- **Form Actions**: Progressive enhancement with form actions
